2026-04-23

We did the 5 extra queries for MongoDB.

1. db.data.aggregate(\[  
     {$match: {   
         officeId: "B02-OFFICE-01",  
         timestamp: {   
           $gte: ISODate("2026-02-01T00:00:00Z"),   
           $lt: ISODate("2026-03-01T00:00:00Z")   
         },  
         $or: \[  
           { temperature: { $gt: 24 } },  
           { humidity: { $lt: 35 } }  
         \]  
       }   
     }  
   \]);  
     
- With this query we get all the records with a temperature greater than 24 and the humidity lighter than 35 stored in the 2nd building in February.

![][image7]

2. db.data.aggregate(\[  
     {$group:  
     {\_id:"$officeId",  
     	temperature\_max:{$max:"$temperature"},  
   		temperature\_min:{$min:"$temperature"}    
     }  
       }  
   \]);  
     
- With this query we get the average temperature and humidity of each office.

![][image8]

3. db.data.aggregate(\[  
     {$match: {  
         $and: \[  
           {$or: \[  
               { officeId: 'B01-OFFICE-01' },  
               { officeId: 'B02-OFFICE-01' }  
             \]  
           },  
           {$or: \[  
               { humidity: { $lt: 50 } },  
               { temperature: { $gt: 21 } }  
             \]  
           }  
         \]  
       }  
     },  
     {$group: {  
         \_id: "$officeId",  
         numReadings: { $sum: 1 },  
         avgTemperature: { $avg: "$temperature" },  
         avgHumidity: { $avg: "$humidity" }  
       }  
     }  
   \]);  
     
- Using this query we get the records from the first office of any building, with the humidity lower than 50 or a temperature higher than 21, showing the number of readings and the average of both temperature and humidity.

![][image9]

4. db.data.aggregate(\[  
     {$match: {  
         $or: \[  
           { humidity: { $gt: 55 } },  
           { temperature: { $gt: 25 } }  
         \]  
       }  
     },  
     {$group: {  
         \_id: "$officeId",  
         alerts: { $sum: 1 }  
       }  
     },  
     {$sort: { alerts: \-1 }},  
     {$project: {  
         \_id: 0,  
         alerts: 1,  
         Ofizinaren\_izena: "$\_id"  
       }  
     }  
   \]);  
     
- With this query we create an alert everytime the temperature gets higher than 25 or the humidity is over 55\. Then we sort the results  in a descendant way counting the total alerts for each office.

![][image10]

5. db.data.aggregate(\[  
     {$match: {  
         officeId: /^B01-/,   
         $or: \[  
           { temperature: { $gt: 25 } },  
           { humidity: { $gt: 50 } }  
         \]  
       }  
     },  
     {$count: "total\_readings"}  
   \])  
     
- Using this query we get a total of readings from the first building’s offices whenever they register a temperature higher than 25 or a humidity higher than 50\.

MySQL script:

const { MongoClient } \= require('mongodb');  
const mysql \= require('mysql2/promise');  
const fs \= require('fs');

async function main() {  
    const mongoUri \= "mongodb://localhost:27017";  
    const mongoClient \= new MongoClient(mongoUri);

    const mysqlConfig \= {  
        host: 'localhost',  
        user: 'root',  
        password: 'rapero2007',  
        database: '3erronka'  
    };

    // \--- 1\. LISTA DE DÍAS HISTÓRICOS QUE NECESITAS \---  
    const fechasHistoricas \= \['2026-02-12', '2026-02-20', '2026-02-25', '2026-04-16', '2026-04-20', '2026-04-21', '2026-04-22'\];

    // \--- 2\. AÑADIMOS "HOY" A LA LISTA AUTOMÁTICAMENTE \---  
    const hoy \= new Date().toISOString().split('T')\[0\];  
    if (\!fechasHistoricas.includes(hoy)) {  
        fechasHistoricas.push(hoy);  
    }

    try {  
        await mongoClient.connect();  
        const connection \= await mysql.createConnection(mysqlConfig);  
        console.log("✅ Conexión establecida.");

        const database \= mongoClient.db('humidity');  
        const collection \= database.collection('data');

        for (const fechaTexto of fechasHistoricas) {  
            const inicioDia \= new Date(\`${fechaTexto}T00:00:00\`);  
            const finDia \= new Date(\`${fechaTexto}T23:59:59\`);

            console.log(\`🔎 Procesando: ${fechaTexto}...\`);

            const pipeline \= \[  
                { $match: { timestamp: { $gte: inicioDia, $lte: finDia } } },  
                {  
                    $group: {  
                        \_id: {  
                            officeId: "$officeId",  
                            hora: { $dateToString: { format: "%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00", date: "$timestamp" } }  
                        },  
                        temp\_avg: { $avg: "$temperature" },  
                        temp\_min: { $min: "$temperature" },  
                        temp\_max: { $max: "$temperature" },  
                        hum\_avg: { $avg: "$humidity" },  
                        hum\_min: { $min: "$humidity" },  
                        hum\_max: { $max: "$humidity" }  
                    }  
                }  
            \];

            const results \= await collection.aggregate(pipeline).toArray();

            if (results.length \> 0) {  
                // Guardar en JSON (para la Web)  
                fs.writeFileSync(\`./reporte\_${fechaTexto}.json\`, JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));

                // Guardar/Actualizar en MySQL (Estrategia de Protección)  
                for (const doc of results) {  
                    const sql \= \`INSERT INTO information (timestamp, office\_id, temp\_avg, temp\_min, temp\_max, hum\_avg, hum\_min, hum\_max)  
                                 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)  
                                 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE temp\_avg \= VALUES(temp\_avg), hum\_avg \= VALUES(hum\_avg)\`;  
                     
                    await connection.query(sql, \[  
                        doc.\_id.hora, doc.\_id.officeId,  
                        doc.temp\_avg.toFixed(2), doc.temp\_min, doc.temp\_max,  
                        doc.hum\_avg.toFixed(2), doc.hum\_min, doc.hum\_max  
                    \]);  
                }  
                console.log(\`   OK: ${results.length} franjas horarias actualizadas.\`);  
            }  
        }  
        await connection.end();  
        console.log("\\n✨ Sincronización completa: Histórico \+ Hoy.");  
    } catch (error) {  
        console.error("❌ Error:", error);  
    } finally {  
        await mongoClient.close();  
    }  
}

main().catch(console.error);

MongoDB script: 

/\*\*  
 \* Script: exportador\_ultima\_hora.js  
 \* Descripción: Extrae datos de la última hora desde MongoDB y los guarda en un archivo .json  
 \*/

const { MongoClient } \= require('mongodb');  
const fs \= require('fs');  
const path \= require('path');

async function exportarUltimaHoraJSON() {  
    // Configuración de conexión (Ajusta si tu puerto o DB son distintos)  
    const uri \= "mongodb://localhost:27017";  
    const dbName \= "humidity";  
    const collectionName \= "data";  
     
    // Carpeta donde se guardarán los JSON  
    const carpetaDestino \= path.join(\_\_dirname, 'descargas\_json');

    // Crear la carpeta si no existe  
    if (\!fs.existsSync(carpetaDestino)) {  
        fs.mkdirSync(carpetaDestino);  
    }

    const client \= new MongoClient(uri);

    try {  
        await client.connect();  
        const db \= client.db(dbName);  
        const coleccion \= db.collection(collectionName);

        // \--- LÓGICA DE TIEMPO (ÚLTIMA HORA) \---  
        const ahora \= new Date();  
         
        // Inicio: Hora actual menos 1, minuto 00:00:00  
        const fechaInicio \= new Date(ahora);  
        fechaInicio.setHours(ahora.getHours() \- 1, 0, 0, 0);

        // Fin: Hora actual menos 1, minuto 59:59:999  
        const fechaFin \= new Date(ahora);  
        fechaFin.setHours(ahora.getHours() \- 1, 59, 59, 999);

        console.log(\`🔎 Buscando datos entre: ${fechaInicio.toLocaleString()} y ${fechaFin.toLocaleString()}\`);

        // \--- CONSULTA A MONGODB \---  
        const query \= {  
            timestamp: { $gte: fechaInicio, $lte: fechaFin }  
        };

        const resultados \= await coleccion.find(query).sort({ timestamp: 1 }).toArray();

        // \--- GENERACIÓN DEL ARCHIVO .JSON \---  
        if (resultados.length \> 0) {  
            // Nombre dinámico: reporte\_YYYY-MM-DD\_HHh.json  
            const fechaISO \= fechaInicio.toISOString().split('T')\[0\];  
            const horaLabel \= fechaInicio.getHours();  
            const nombreArchivo \= \`reporte\_${fechaISO}\_${horaLabel}h.json\`;  
            const rutaCompleta \= path.join(carpetaDestino, nombreArchivo);

            // Escribir el archivo  
            fs.writeFileSync(rutaCompleta, JSON.stringify(resultados, null, 2));  
             
            console.log(\`✅ EXPORTACIÓN EXITOSA\`);  
            console.log(\`📄 Archivo: ${nombreArchivo}\`);  
            console.log(\`📍 Ubicación: ${rutaCompleta}\`);  
            console.log(\`📊 Total registros: ${resultados.length}\`);  
        } else {  
            console.log("⚠️ No se encontraron datos en el rango de la última hora.");  
            console.log("Nota: Si tus datos son antiguos (ej: febrero), este script no mostrará resultados hoy.");  
        }

    } catch (error) {  
        console.error("❌ Error durante la ejecución:", error);  
    } finally {  
        await client.close();  
    }  
}

// Ejecutar la función  
exportarUltimaHoraJSON();

![][image13]

And this is the folder where we have the MongoDb script with all it´s .json files.

After making both scripts we created a task for the MySQL script using the “Task scheduler” program to run the script every hour. This script has two functions: first, it checks the historical data for errors and fills in any missing data with newly generated information; and second, it dynamically updates the data for the current day.

This strategy guarantees data integrity and high availability, allowing the website to function using JSON backup files even if the main database fails.

We also created a task for the MongoDB script, this one will be activated daily at 10am, this is because in MongoDB the data is not summarized so there are a lot more records than in MySQL, that is why we program it daily and not for each hour.

![][image14]

Here are both of the tasks in the “Task Scheduler” program.
